Name: Overture CH selected administrative coverage
Source: Overture Maps divisions; OpenStreetMap; geoBoundaries; Esri Community Maps; Wikidata semantic review
License: ODbL-1.0; CC-BY-4.0 source attributes; CC0-1.0 semantic metadata
Attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; Overture Maps Foundation; geoBoundaries; Esri Community Maps contributors; Wikidata contributors
Coverage: CH: selected complete source polygons, not all cities. Altstadt, Zurich
Semantics: Reviewed source subtypes, entity types and hierarchy. Administrative city/municipal extents and provider-defined neighborhoods are visibly marked. Tokyo remains a region fallback, not a fabricated city boundary. Source/review inputs accompany this derivative database.
